61: C is correct because AWS Secrets Manager is purpose-built for storing database credentials securely and supports automatic rotation on a configurable schedule, with native support for rotating Amazon RDS credentials without any custom code. The EC2 instance retrieves the secret at runtime through its IAM role, so credentials are never hardcoded in the application, and rotation happens with no application changes. This eliminates the operational overhead of building and managing custom rotation workflows with EventBridge and Lambda.
62: D is correct because a certificate issued by an external certificate authority cannot be issued directly by ACM; it must be imported into ACM, and ACM managed renewal applies only to ACM-issued certificates, not imported ones. Therefore the architect must import the external SSL/TLS certificate, apply it to the ALB, receive an EventBridge notification when the certificate nears expiration, and rotate the certificate manually each year by importing the renewed one.
63: A is correct because an S3 event notification that triggers a Lambda function is a fully serverless, event-driven pipeline that scales automatically with demand and costs nothing when idle, making it the most cost-effective choice for a workload that will grow rapidly. Amazon S3 provides durable, low-cost storage for both the original PDF files and the converted JPG images, and Lambda performs the conversion without provisioning or managing any servers.
64: D is correct because Amazon FSx for Windows File Server provides fully managed, native SMB file storage in AWS for the migrated Windows workloads, while the Amazon FSx File Gateway deployed on premises provides low-latency local access to that same shared data over the existing Site-to-Site VPN connection. Because both sides expose standard SMB file shares, users and applications keep their existing file access patterns unchanged, and AWS manages the storage infrastructure, minimizing operational overhead.
65: C is correct because Amazon Textract is a managed OCR service designed to extract text from documents, including PDF and JPEG files, so the Lambda code does not need to maintain OCR libraries. Amazon Comprehend Medical is a HIPAA-eligible managed service purpose-built to detect protected health information in text. Using these two managed services keeps the Lambda modification minimal and avoids the operational overhead of maintaining Python libraries or training custom SageMaker models.
66: C is correct because S3 Standard-IA has a lower per-GB storage price than S3 Standard while still providing millisecond access and multi-Availability-Zone durability, which fits data that is rarely accessed after the first 30 days but must remain immediately accessible because it is critical and hard to reproduce. A lifecycle policy moves objects automatically after 30 days and deletes them after 4 years, matching the retention requirement. Glacier adds retrieval delays, and One Zone-IA sacrifices resilience, so Standard-IA is the most cost-effective option that preserves instant access.
67: D is correct because duplicate records occur when processing and writing to the RDS table takes longer than the queue's visibility timeout, causing SQS to return the message to the queue so another instance processes it and inserts the record again. Using the ChangeMessageVisibility API call to increase the visibility timeout keeps each message hidden from other consumers until the application finishes processing and explicitly deletes it, ensuring each message is processed only once.
68: A is correct because AWS Direct Connect provides highly available private connectivity with consistent low latency to the Region, meeting the primary performance requirement. A VPN connection as the backup minimizes cost compared to a second Direct Connect connection, and the company stated it is willing to accept slower traffic if the primary connection fails, which the internet-based VPN tunnel satisfies.
69: B is correct because distributing the Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones and configuring Aurora as Multi-AZ eliminates the single points of failure at both the compute and database layers, with Aurora failing over automatically in well under a minute and with minimal data loss. Amazon RDS Proxy additionally pools and manages database connections so that failovers and instance replacements do not overwhelm the application. All of this is achieved through configuration rather than rebuilding the architecture, requiring the least operational effort.
70: C is correct because an Application Load Balancer operates at layer 7 and can perform HTTP health checks against the application URL, allowing it to detect the HTTP errors that the layer-4 Network Load Balancer cannot see. Configuring the Auto Scaling group to replace unhealthy instances based on those health checks automatically restarts the failing web service whenever errors are detected, without writing any custom scripts or code.
71: B is correct because DynamoDB point-in-time recovery continuously backs up the table and allows restoring to any point in time within the last 35 days, giving a recovery point of at most a few minutes, which satisfies the 15-minute RPO. Restoring the table to a new DynamoDB table is a managed operation that can typically be completed well within the 1-hour RTO. Global tables address regional failover rather than data corruption, and EBS snapshots do not apply to DynamoDB tables.
72: D is correct because an S3 VPC gateway endpoint lets instances in the VPC reach Amazon S3 through private AWS network routing without traversing an internet gateway or NAT gateway, eliminating the NAT gateway data processing and hourly charges that drive up data transfer costs. The attached endpoint policy restricts access to only the required S3 buckets. Because the buckets are in the same Region, the gateway endpoint is supported and traffic stays entirely on the AWS network.
73: C is correct because the connection from the on-premises network arrives through the company's internet connection, so the bastion host's security group must allow inbound access only from the company's external public IP range. D is correct because within the VPC the application instances communicate with the bastion host over its private IP address, so their security group should allow inbound SSH only from the private IP of the bastion host. Together these rules ensure only the company's network can reach the bastion host and only the bastion host can reach the application instances.
74: A is correct because the application is a public-facing web tier using HTTPS, so its security group must allow inbound traffic on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 so that internet users can reach it. C is correct because the database tier should only accept Microsoft SQL Server traffic on port 1433 from the security group of the web tier, which ensures that only the application's web tier can connect to the database and keeps the private subnet locked down.
75: A is correct because Amazon API Gateway with AWS Lambda creates a serverless application layer that scales automatically to handle varying transaction volumes, while Amazon SQS decouples the application services so that when one tier becomes overloaded, transactions are buffered in the queue instead of being dropped. This fully managed, event-driven design modernizes the application and is the most operationally efficient because there are no servers to provision, patch, or manage.
76: B is correct because AWS DataSync is the purpose-built service for reliably moving large volumes of file data from on-premises storage systems such as a SAN to Amazon S3, with automated scheduling, integrity validation, and bandwidth management. Running the transfers over AWS Direct Connect provides a private, consistent network path for the sensitive 10 TB of daily JSON files, avoiding the variability and security exposure of the public internet. AWS DMS is a database migration service and is not suitable for moving JSON files.
77: C is correct because Amazon API Gateway provides a fully managed API endpoint without provisioning any EC2 instances, Amazon Kinesis Data Streams ingests the streaming data in real time, and a Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream with an attached AWS Lambda transformation delivers the transformed data to Amazon S3. Every component in this pipeline is fully managed and serverless, which minimizes operational overhead compared to hosting an API on EC2, while AWS Glue is designed for batch ETL rather than real-time streaming.
78: B is correct because AWS Backup provides a centralized, fully managed service for creating backup schedules and retention policies, including a seven-year retention rule, for the DynamoDB table. This is the most operationally efficient solution because it requires only policy configuration, with no custom Lambda functions, no EventBridge rules, and no manual on-demand backups to maintain over the seven-year period.
79: A is correct because on-demand capacity mode instantly accommodates any level of read and write traffic, including sudden and unpredictable spikes in the evenings, without any capacity planning and without throttled requests. Provisioned capacity with auto scaling cannot react fast enough to very quick spikes because auto scaling takes several minutes to adjust, which risks throttling during rapid traffic bursts.
80: B is correct because modifying the launch permission property of the AMI to share it privately with only the MSP Partner's AWS account keeps the AMI and its EBS snapshots inaccessible to everyone else, which is far more secure than making them public. Because the EBS snapshots are encrypted with a customer managed KMS key, the key policy must also be modified to allow the partner account to use that key so it can decrypt the snapshots and launch the AMI. This is the documented, most secure approach for sharing an encrypted AMI between AWS accounts.
